說明: 《千秋硯》主角表情頭像（知墨、蘅各三種：笑、哭、驚）。劇本寫【蘅｜笑】時會換成「蘅_笑」這張圖；還沒有圖的時候，遊戲會自動用平常的頭像。種子沿用原本的頭像，讓臉和衣服盡量一樣。

items.name: 知墨_笑
items.prompt: A gentle 27-year-old Taiwanese man, short neat black hair, calm attentive eyes, wearing a plain dark crew-neck T-shirt with a canvas work apron, the look of a careful book restorer. Expression: smiling warmly, eyes softly crinkled with happiness. Same character design, same clothes and hairstyle as the usual portrait.

items.name: 知墨_哭
items.prompt: A gentle 27-year-old Taiwanese man, short neat black hair, calm attentive eyes, wearing a plain dark crew-neck T-shirt with a canvas work apron, the look of a careful book restorer. Expression: crying quietly, tears running down the cheeks, eyes glistening, trembling lips. Same character design, same clothes and hairstyle as the usual portrait.

items.name: 知墨_驚
items.prompt: A gentle 27-year-old Taiwanese man, short neat black hair, calm attentive eyes, wearing a plain dark crew-neck T-shirt with a canvas work apron, the look of a careful book restorer. Expression: surprised, eyes wide open, lips slightly parted, eyebrows raised. Same character design, same clothes and hairstyle as the usual portrait.
